title: Koala waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='15' fill='#8B9BB4'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='9' fill='#C8D4E8'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='15' fill='#8B9BB4'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='9' fill='#C8D4E8'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#8B9BB4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#C8D4E8'/>
  
  <!-- left arm (resting) -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='72' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#8B9BB4' transform='rotate(20 30 72)'/>
  
  <!-- right arm (waving up) -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='62' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#8B9BB4' transform='rotate(-35 72 62)'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='50' r='6' fill='#8B9BB4'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='50' r='3' fill='#C8D4E8'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='26' fill='#8B9BB4'/>
  
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#C8D4E8'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3A3A5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='48' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#7A8AAA' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='4' fill='#1E1E36'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='4' fill='#1E1E36'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#E0F0FF'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#E0F0FF'/>
  
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M45 56 Q50 60 55 56' stroke='#5A6A84' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='50' r='4' fill='#F0A0A0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='50' r='4' fill='#F0A0A0' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- waving hand fingers -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#8B9BB4'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#8B9BB4'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#8B9BB4'/>
</svg>
